included_organizations: Bemerewe imiryango yose itari politiki: urugero amashuri, kaminuza, ibigo byuburezi na siyanse, amashyirahamwe y’ababyeyi n’abanyeshuri, amasosiyete, imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta, imiryango y’amadini
united_earth_is_1: Hariho abantu benshi bashaka gukiza umubumbe wacu. Amashyirahamwe atabarika, amashyirahamwe, ibigo nabantu bonyine. Ariko ntituzi undi.
united_earth_is_3: Tugomba guhuza hamwe kugirango twerekane uburyo urugendo rwacu rukomeye. Niba tuzi umubare, dushobora gufasha abantu guhindura imyumvire yabo ku bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere kugira ubutwari n'icyizere. Turashobora guha abantu imbaraga zo gutangiza ingamba zabo zo kurengera ikirere. Gusa hamwe dushobora guhindura isi tugakiza ikirere!
united_earth_is_4: Hindura isi wiyandikishije kurubuga rwacu! Turi benshi!
united_earth_is_5: Turagutumiye cyane gusangira aya makuru n'inshuti, abafatanyabikorwa ndetse n'abo tuziranye.
united_earth_is_7: Abanyeshuri 200 n'abarimu 30 ku ishuri rya Otirishiya
united_earth_is_8: Umushinga wo kwitabira ecolabel yo muri Otirishiya
about_us_2: Niba twerekanye uko turi, dushobora gufasha abantu guhindura imyumvire yabo ku bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere kuva kwiheba kugera ku butwari no kwigirira icyizere. Turashobora guha abantu imbaraga zo gutangiza ingamba zabo zo kurengera ikirere.
about_us_3: Ariko ikiruta byose: Ntabwo twakongera kumva twenyine kandi nta mbaraga dufite. Byaduhuza. Byaduha ibyiringiro, imbaraga, ubutwari nicyizere. Twakumva duhujwe kwisi yose - dukiza umubumbe wacu kandi tugakora ejo hazaza heza.
about_us_4: Intego yacu ni uguha abantu ubutwari, icyizere n'imbaraga zo gutangiza ingamba zabo bwite zo kurengera ikirere.
about_us_5: Icyitonderwa: Nta ntambara kubera ibitekerezo bitandukanye - kujijuka, ntabwo agahato gakwiye kutubera ishingiro ryo kurinda isi yacu.
about_us_6: Abantu 100, bose bavuga indimi zitandukanye, batonda umurongo mubwato bugana ku isoko. Hafi ya bose mubwato bazi ibintu biteye akaga. Ariko hafi ya bose batekereza ko ariwe wenyine ubizi. Abantu bose baratekereza bati: "Nakora iki?" "Gutonda umurongo mu kindi cyerekezo ntacyo bimaze!" Kandi buriwese yishora mumyitwarire isanzwe ya kera. Byagenda bite mugihe gitunguranye abantu bose bamenyanye - bazi ko abantu bose bashaka gusubira inyuma kandi ko bashobora kuvugana?
about_us_8: United-Earth2025 - umushinga wo kwitabira ecolabel yo muri Otirishiya.
about_us_9: Urubuga hamwe nimbuga nkoranyambaga bihujwe bikozwe nabanyeshuri 200 nabarimu mwishuri rya Otirishiya.
about_us_10: Umushinga wakozwe nkumushinga wo kwitabira ecolabel yo muri Otirishiya. Ibintu byose byurubuga byakozwe nkumushinga wishuri.
about_us_11: Turashobora gukurikiza amadini atandukanye, tugatandukana mumyaka n'inkomoko, ariko twese turashaka gukiza umubumbe wacu. Abitabiriye amahugurwa bose ni abakorerabushake.
